records.text: A Parliamentary System of Government is one in which

options.A: all political parties in the Parliament are represented in the Government
options.B: the Government is responsible to the Parliament and can be removed by it
options.C: the Government is elected by the people and can be removed by them
options.D: the Government is chosen by the Parliament but cannot be removed by it before completion of a fixed term

records.text: In the context of Colonial India, Shah Nawaz Khan, Prem Kumar Sehgal and Gurbaksh Singh Dhillon are remembered as

options.A: leaders of Swadeshi and Boycott Movement
options.B: members of the Interim Government in 1946
options.C: members of the Drafting Committee in the Constituent Assembly
options.D: officers of the Indian National Army

records.text:
Consider the following statements:
1. If the election of the President of India is declared void by the Supreme Court of India, all acts done by him/her in the performance of duties of his/her office of President before the date of decision become invalid.
2. Election for the post of the President of India can be postponed on the ground that some Legislative Assemblies have been dissolved and elections are yet to take place.
3. When a Bill is presented to the President of India, the Constitution prescribes time limits within which he/she has to declare his/her assent.
How many of the above statements are correct?
records.note: Misidentified import was the third statement of Series B Q16, not Q3. Restored the full three-statement question from page 2; official B-series Q16 accepts D.
